entities.summary: Roja Chamankar, born 20 May 1981 in Borazjan, Bushehr Province, Iran, in southern Iran, is a Persian poet. Roja Chamankar was a poets & playwrights from Borazjan (b. 1981-05-10, Borazjan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
